note: Mercer County KY (Harrodsburg PVA) parcels are only published through Schneider qPublic (GIS maps are subscriber-only; public search is not a parcel service) and paid vendors (Regrid, ReportAllUSA, Rockford Map). KY DGI kygisserver hosts PVA parcel MapServices for Webster, Barren, Caldwell, Nelson, Pendleton, Spencer, Trimble, Wayne, Hardin counties but not Mercer. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches found no public Mercer KY parcel service or file.
